profile: Protagonist Therapeutics discovers and develops peptide medicines for inflammatory, immunologic, hematologic, and metabolic diseases. Its partnered products include ICOTYDE (icotrokinra), an approved oral IL-23 receptor antagonist for plaque psoriasis commercialized by Johnson & Johnson, and MIMRYLO (rusfertide), approved for erythrocytosis in adults with polycythemia vera and commercialized by Takeda. The company also advances wholly owned peptide drug candidates.
